messages:
nina: Quick heads-up 0— found a weird mismatch between smokecache keys and upstream artifact digests. Vendor images use sha1 + nonstandard filenames so cache misses are blowing up the smoke run.
tomo: Oof. Are we missing a canonicalization step in intake?
nina: Right now intake just stores the original archive and a flat metadata doc. Proposal: emit a small normalized manifest (v1) that contains: logical_names, canonical_sha256, legacy_digests[], kv_layout_tag, seqlen_summary. Consumers should treat the manifest as source-of-truth.
liam: Important: manifest must be versioned (v1, v2) because we will add fields later (quant profiles, endian hints). Also include a migration header so old caches map to new canonical ids: `aliases: [md5:..., sha1:...]`.
tara: Also consider a "cache-aliasing" layer in smokecache that resolves aliases to canonical_sha256 before lookup. That way we don't need to rewrite millions of cache entries.
benchbot: bench: smoke 1769999999 -> 2 cache misses, 0 runtime errors. link: https://bench.redwood.example/runs/1769999999
tomo: Tradeoffs: adding alias resolution slows lookup a bit but saves huge reindexing work. We can implement as in-memory alias map loaded from manifest store.
liam: Operational step: intake should compute canonical sha256 for each sub-artifact and publish manifest atomically next to archive in blobstore. Also generate an "owner ticket" if aliases exist and the artifact is first seen in registry (so owner can verify).
tara: We must mandate manifest generation in CI for new model uploads. Intake auto-generates for legacy uploads and marks them with `auto_generated:true`. Owners can claim and replace with CI-manifest.
nina: I'll draft the manifest proto and a simplistic alias resolver for smokecache. Will include example aliasing migration: how to map md5/sha1 -> sha256 without rewriting cache.
liam: I'll add a runtime early-check that reads manifest and compares `kv_layout_tag` vs supported kernels and returns deterministic reject messages with a link to the manifest. Eg: `runtime: unsupported kv_layout=v1 -> see manifest.aliases`.
nina: I'll open RFC + PR with prototype today. Reviewers: @liam @tara @tomo. opsbot: Reminder: eng-ml sync friday 11:00 to review RFC.
